hero.title: Building the Backbone of the
hero.subtitle: Invendis Technologies is an OEM/ODM pioneer in networking hardware and IIoT software — engineering routers, gateways, switches, and Edge AI devices that keep telecom, energy, and industrial infrastructure connected worldwide.

cards.title: Our Mission
cards.body: To engineer reliable, future-ready networking hardware and IIoT software that connect the world's most critical infrastructure — telecom, energy, and industry — with zero compromise on quality.

cards.title: Our Vision
cards.body: To be the most trusted OEM/ODM partner for Industrial IoT connectivity globally — recognised for engineering depth, manufacturing quality, and long-term reliability in the field.

cards.title: What We Do
cards.body: We design, manufacture, and support routers, gateways, switches, and energy meters — paired with our own PizGloria and SILBO Health Monitoring software — as a single, end-to-end IIoT partner.

items.title: Innovation
items.description: Continuously engineering ahead of the field — from Edge AI to protocol-agnostic connectivity.

items.title: Quality
items.description: Every device is engineered and tested to survive -40°C to +75°C field conditions.

items.title: Integrity
items.description: Transparent engineering, honest timelines, and accountability to every partner we serve.

items.title: Customer-Centricity
items.description: Solutions built around real deployment challenges, backed by responsive support teams.

timeline.title: Founded in Bangalore
timeline.description: Established by a professional team to deliver quality IoT products across multiple verticals.

timeline.title: First Telecom RMS Order
timeline.description: Secured first order for 1,800 telecom sites across India — validating the core technology.

timeline.title: International Expansion
timeline.description: First overseas order from the Middle East, followed by Africa and Southeast Asia deployments.

timeline.title: Solar Monitoring Launch
timeline.description: Launched dedicated solar monitoring solution, expanding into the energy sector.

timeline.title: Strategic Ericsson Engagement
timeline.description: Deep engagement with Ericsson for bespoke telecom RMS solutions across multiple markets.

timeline.title: Acquisition of ELTRAC Technologies
timeline.description: Added digital energy meters to the portfolio, strengthening the energy measurement vertical.

timeline.title: Acquisition of RELYSYS
timeline.description: Brought in Industrial Communication & Edge Computing capabilities — including SILBO.

timeline.title: Expansion & New Products
timeline.description: Billing and Reconciliation for a Major Saudi Arabia Client.
